query: My testnet dapp uses Stellar Wallets Kit. Users want to connect their mobile wallets with WalletConnect. How do I add that?
expected_behavior: Reads dapp/walletconnect.md rather than answering from memory
Imports WalletConnectModule from @creit-tech/stellar-wallets-kit/modules/wallet-connect and adds it next to defaultModules() in StellarWalletsKit.init, since defaultModules() does not include it
Passes a projectId from the Reown Dashboard and app metadata (name, description, url, icons)
Sets allowedChains to WalletConnectTargetChain.TESTNET to match the kit's testnet network, because the module defaults to stellar:pubnet only
